description: This file defines the class Vtiger_PDF_PagerViewer, a specialized viewer component for rendering PDF page numbers or pager elements within the vtiger CRM project. It extends the base viewer class and includes methods for setting the model, calculating height, and displaying the pager element within a PDF document.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_PagerViewer
classes.description: A PDF viewer class specialized for displaying pager or page number information within PDF documents in the vtiger CRM environment.

methods.name: setModel
methods.description: Sets the model object to be used for retrieving display format configuration.

methods.name: totalHeight
methods.description: Returns a fixed height value for the pager display element.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Initializes display settings; currently does nothing.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the pager (page number) in the PDF at the specified position, using a format string from the model if available.
